summary: Verified production chain AppDelegate → Capture/Recording/Scratchpad + SettingsStore.load; Capture → ScreenshotWorkflowController; Workflow → EditorWindowController; Workflow also builds EditorCanvasView for annotatedBaseImage; WorkflowImagePersistenceLogic/WorkflowReopenMetadataLogic use PNGMetadata; SettingsStore is cross-feature. Corrections for the rooms map: do not sell Shared helpers as one module; do not park UniqueFileURLLogic as Workflow-only; do not imply PNGMetadata/ImageSafety/CoreLogic stay inside one room.
findings: CORRECTION — Shared helpers: present as distributed tools (clipboard, backup, alerts, purge, theme, small input helpers), not one unified module or real hallway. AppDelegate is launch/orchestrator (loads settings; starts capture, recording, scratchpad; busy-gates features), not a peer utility other rooms call.

CORRECTION — UniqueFileURLLogic: currently listed under Workflow in 01-rooms.html, but production callers span ScreenRecordingService, ScreenshotServiceCoreLogic, ScratchpadService, ScreenshotWorkflowCoreLogic, ClipboardService. For a noncoder map, treat it as a shared tool, not Workflow furniture.

CORRECTION — PNGMetadata in Editing alone: primary embed/extract production callers are WorkflowImagePersistenceLogic and WorkflowReopenMetadataLogic; ImageSafety/EditorCanvasState also touch it. Editing-room ownership overstates isolation.

CORRECTION — Capture/Editing sealed rooms: ScreenshotServiceCoreLogic.pngData/bitmapRepresentation are also called from EditorCanvasView, ScreenshotWorkflowController, WorkflowReopenMetadataLogic, WorkflowImagePersistenceLogic.
CORRECTION — Workflow→Editing copy: not only “opens the editor”; annotatedBaseImage constructs EditorCanvasView(...).compositeImage() and skips EditorWindowController.
CAUTION 1: Keep doors/spine schematic. Rooms are inferred file buckets, not package boundaries; cross-room call sites above are the proof.

CAUTION 2: Do not imply feature rooms run independently. AppDelegate busy-gates screenshot/recording/scratchpad/video-rename; SettingsStore is read/updated across Capture, Editing, Workflow, Recording, Preferences UI.
decisions: Only corrections + two isolation cautions returned; confirmed edges not listed as fixes.
Shared helpers must be distributed tools, not a unified module; AppDelegate called out separately as orchestrator.
No edits, tests, delegation, or branch/worktree changes; existing source left as-is.
